title: TUI: stepper modal for /search-provider (select provider, enter fields, test connection)

AC2.note: review-orchestrator (T4) confirmed args-given branch byte-identical to pre-change; diff --stat shows only new bare-arg code inserted, existing branch untouched.

AC8.note: git diff --stat main HEAD across all 4 commits: only src/tui/tui-shell.ts and src/tui/tui-shell.test.ts changed; verified by flow-orchestrator directly twice.

AC9.note: keryx health run --changed --since main --source typescript,complexity: PASS, project score 93, no gate conditions triggered.
